description: NRLMSIS 2.1 adds a nitric-oxide density representation to the empirical atmosphere model. Satellite observations inform altitude, season, solar and geomagnetic dependencies for upper-atmosphere calculations. The resource is documented by NRL. The documented physical domain is Thermosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Runs-on-Request, Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The selected release adds nitric oxide to version 2.0; it is not a new independent model family. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
